Introducing Farcaster Articles!

## The Basics
- **Title and cover image.** They show on the feed card and in share previews.

- **A public page.** Every article opens on web and mobile without an account, so the link works anywhere you share it.
- **In the feed and on your profile.** An article shows as a card; tap to read the rest. Replies, recasts and likes work like any cast.
- **On the protocol.** Behind the scenes, an article is a chain of casts, so other clients without article support show it as a series of threaded casts.\

---
Dividers
---
## How to write an Article
1. Open Articles from the left sidebar (on web)
2. Add a title and a cover image
3. Write, format, and embed casts and images
4. Preview it as a reader will see it
5. Publish to the feed and your profile
Writing is limited to web for now; reading works everywhere (including outside of Farcaster!) Drafts save as you type.
